adjudication.rationale: The diff adds substantial new behavior that is not exercised by specs: `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed` does real parsing (`SimpleRSS.parse open(...)`), per-item URL fallback (`url = i.id if url.blank? || url !~ /^https?/`), and content handling (`CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)`), but `spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb` only tests `execute` gating and stubs `poll_feed` in every example, so none of that logic is covered. `TopicEmbed.import_remote` (Readability extraction via `Readability::Document.new(open(url).read, ...)`) is newly introduced but `spec/models/topic_embed_spec.rb` only calls `.import`, never `.import_remote`. The new job `Jobs::RetrieveTopic` has no spec file at all. This is a concrete, diff-grounded missing-coverage issue for newly added parsing/import paths.
